label: DS-15 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the three-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 15 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit AAA1 and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the AAA1 source working identifier, the individual DS-15 genes and proteins, the DS-15A/DS-15B/DS-15C HMM profile rows, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, MinD ATPase and DUF6988 HHpred-domain annotations, the absent DS-15 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved DS-15 component activity and phage readouts, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
